page_title: ATM 2-1 BET | Atletico Madrid v Betis 03/03/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+3' Rodrigo Riquelme (Atl. Madrid) is unlucky with a goal-bound effort from the edge of the box. A brilliant save by Rui Silva stops the ball from going inside the left post.
90+3' We can have a look at the statistics now, shots on target are 11:6.
90' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Johnny departs the field of play to be replaced by Abde Ezzalzouli (Betis).
90' Rodrigo Riquelme (Atl. Madrid) was close to scoring after he unleashed a powerful shot which went a whisker over the crossbar.
89' Betis failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.

88' Youssouf Sabaly (Betis) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort. Betis force their opponents to concede a corner.
86' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Stefan Savic (Atl. Madrid) is coming onto the pitch as Alvaro Morata cannot continue after picking up an injury.
85' Cesar Soto Grado shows a yellow card to Guido Rodriguez (Betis) for a tough tackle.
83' The free kick from long range, taken by Betis, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
81' Diego Simeone decides to make a substitution. Memphis Depay will be replaced by Reinildo Mandava (Atl. Madrid).
81' Here's the change. Samuel Lino leaves the pitch and Rodrigo Riquelme (Atl. Madrid) comes on as a substitute.

79' Jan Oblak makes a sensational save to thwart a huge chance. A rebound falls to Guido Rodriguez (Betis) on the edge of the box and he strikes goalwards towards the bottom right corner, but the goalkeeper manages to dive and punch the ball onto the post and away.
78' Betis have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
78' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Betis.

78' Ayoze Perez (Betis) came close to scoring. He connected with a pass inside the box and perhaps should have done better than direct his shot straight at Jan Oblak. The ball goes out for a corner. Betis can continue in their attacking effort.
76' Nahuel Molina (Atl. Madrid) tries to find Alvaro Morata, but he puts too much power on the through ball.
75' Saul Niguez (Atl. Madrid) collects a pass inside the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender.
72' Manuel Pellegrini has decided to make a change. Ayoze Perez (Betis) replaces Chimy Avila.
72' We are about to witness a subsitution. Juan Miranda (Betis) for Hector Bellerin.
72' Chimy Avila (Betis) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.
70' Alvaro Morata (Atl. Madrid) is adjudged offside.
69' Atl. Madrid fail to score from a corner as Rui Silva (Betis) leaps to collect the ball.
67' German Pezzella (Betis) will miss the next game.
67' A yellow card for a tackle by German Pezzella (Betis). Cesar Soto Grado doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
63' It will be a substitution. Saul Niguez (Atl. Madrid) is ready to enter the pitch as Koke walks off.
62' Diego Simeone has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Nahuel Molina (Atl. Madrid) replacing Rodrigo de Paul.
62' 2 - 1 Nice piece of skill by William Carvalho (Betis) as he collected a pass and fired an unstoppable thunderbolt into the top right corner, leaving the goalkeeper stranded.

60' Mario Hermoso (Atl. Madrid) produces a ferocious strike from the edge of the box. His dangerous effort towards the bottom left corner is blocked by Rui Silva, who pulls off a superb save to keep the ball out of the net.
60' Corner kick. Memphis Depay (Atl. Madrid) is ready to send the ball into the box.
60' Rodrigo de Paul (Atl. Madrid) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. Now Atl. Madrid have a corner.
59' Chimy Avila (Betis) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
55' Marcos Llorente (Atl. Madrid) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.
52' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Atl. Madrid, is overhit and the ball goes out of play.
51' Hector Bellerin (Betis) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
51' Jan Oblak pulls off a fine save! Willian Jose (Betis) attempts to head home after a precise cross into the box. He aims his header low towards the middle, but the effort is kept out.
50' An opponent rises to his feet after being downed by Pablo Barrios (Atl. Madrid). Cesar Soto Grado saw the sliding tackle and blows for a foul.
48' Rodrigo de Paul (Atl. Madrid) received a clever through ball which could have put him in a promising position, but the defence was alert to the danger.
46' Half-time substitution. Marc Roca (Betis) will not participate anymore and Guido Rodriguez is coming on.
46' Manuel Pellegrini has made a change at the break. William Carvalho has come on in place of Rodri (Betis).
46' The second half gets underway.
45+5' Cesar Soto Grado blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+5' The linesman points to the corner flag, Betis are going to take it.
45+2' Samuel Lino (Atl. Madrid) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.
45' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
44' 2 - 0 Alvaro Morata (Atl. Madrid) gets to the rebound in the goalmouth and plants a header home.

44' Rodrigo de Paul (Atl. Madrid) blew a promising chance when he got to a rebound just outside the penalty area. He struck it towards the bottom right corner, but Rui Silva pulled off a nice save to stop the attempt.
43' Atl. Madrid win a corner.
43' Memphis Depay (Atl. Madrid) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender. Atl. Madrid have been awarded a corner kick.
42' Memphis Depay (Atl. Madrid) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
41' Betis take a short corner kick.
41' This shall not pass! Rodri (Betis) lines up a shot from the edge of the box and goes for goal, but the effort is well blocked by a defender. Good work from Betis as they win a corner.
40' Mario Hermoso (Atl. Madrid) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
38' Marcos Llorente (Atl. Madrid) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
37' Rodrigo de Paul (Atl. Madrid) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit chip pass.
34' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Hector Bellerin (Betis).
33' Jan Oblak stretches to his right and makes a brilliant save! Johnny (Betis) met a rebound outside the box and attempted to beat the keeper into the bottom left corner.
32' Memphis Depay (Atl. Madrid) sends a wonderful cross from the corner kick. However, the defence works perfectly to clear the ball and avert the threat.
28' Alvaro Morata (Atl. Madrid) fails to turn the rebound in from a promising position. The goalkeeper pulls off a superb save and denies his effort.
28' Alvaro Morata (Atl. Madrid) failed to convert his penalty kick as he couldn't stay cool.
28' Alvaro Morata (Atl. Madrid) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
28' Here comes the VAR decision: PENALTY to Atl. Madrid!

26' There's a break in play and referee Cesar Soto Grado must have got a signal in his ear as he indicates he will check that earlier penalty claim by Atl. Madrid using VAR. This could be interesting!
25' Alvaro Morata (Atl. Madrid) makes his forward run a little too early and is caught in an offside position after his teammate tries to play a pass to him.
25' Alvaro Morata (Atl. Madrid) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
22' A pass by Willian Jose (Betis) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
20' A corner kick by Betis is thwarted by the well prepared Jan Oblak (Atl. Madrid).
19' A cross into the box from Rodri (Betis) is cleared. The referee points to the corner flag and Betis will take a corner.
18' The foul by Rodrigo de Paul (Atl. Madrid) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Cesar Soto Grado.
17' Cesar Soto Grado has a clear sight and sees a foul from German Pezzella (Betis).
14' Alvaro Morata (Atl. Madrid) breaks into the box and goes over after a challenge from an opposition player, but the ref signals NO penalty!
13' Memphis Depay (Atl. Madrid) has a sight of goal and shoots goalwards, but the goalkeeper makes a comfortable save.
8' 1 - 0 Rui Silva (Betis) puts the ball beyond his own goalkeeper to register an own goal!
7' Marcos Llorente (Atl. Madrid) breaks past challenges inside the box, but puts too much pace on his pass to Rodrigo de Paul.
6' Cesar Soto Grado blows his whistle. Hector Bellerin (Betis) commits a foul after dangerous play.
4' Rodrigo de Paul (Atl. Madrid) spurns a great opportunity from inside the 6-yard box. The ball flies narrowly wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Betis.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are out at last! Betis will take the kick-off.
Cesar Soto Grado got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
